text:
sarah_sales: Quick handoff for AceroHealth (AC-3487) — signing complete, moving to activation. Contract: Dedicated plan, committed throughput ~25k tokens/day; renewal ~11 months out. Primary contact: me until EoW, then we'll hand to account owner.

sarah_sales: Tech notes / blockers: SSO (Okta SAML) not verified; infra needs inbound allowlist for their static IP ranges; observed KV-cache warmup causing 200-400ms token latency spikes on long chat sessions. There is an open GH ticket #7821 for model-version mismatch on the v2 endpoint (sample logs attached in 1Password).

sarah_sales: They want a 1-hour enablement session + a test plan for private deploy. I put staging creds in 1Password path: /AceroHealth/staging. Please own scheduling and triage. @lucas_cs can you pick this up? :wave:

lucas_cs: Got it — I can own activation. First step: schedule enablement w/ product + infra. Anya can you run enablement and capture prompts/SLAs? I'll open a CS playbook ticket.

anya_enable: Yep, I can do enablement. Need staging API key and example prompt set (happy path + edge cases). Also please confirm whether they'll use streaming responses — that changes the demo flow.

sarah_sales: They plan to use streaming for real-time triage. Staging key is in 1Password. Prompt set: I'll drop a short bundle in the same path (includes 8 representative prompts).

kevin_support: I'll take the allowlist and SSO onboarding. Can someone paste the customer IP ranges and Okta metadata? I need to open a support ticket for net ops.

lucas_cs: IP ranges are in the 1Password note too (AceroHealth-net-ranges). Okta metadata: XML SAML metadata attached. I'll create the support ticket and tag infra.

mike_platform: I'll triage GH #7821 (model mismatch). Quick note: probable root cause is model aliasing after a rollback. ETA for initial investigation: 24 hours. If it's a live regression we'll escalate to runtime team.

deploy-bot: New ticket created: ENG-4219 assigned to mike_platform for initial triage of GH #7821. Support ticket SUP-1987 created for allowlist + SSO (assigned kevin_support).

lucas_cs: Action list: 1) Anya to run enablement + capture prompts (owner: anya_enable). 2) Kevin to own allowlist/Okta (owner: kevin_support). 3) Mike to triage GH #7821 and report root cause (owner: mike_platform). 4) Lucas to track activation checklist and timeline, schedule canary traffic for private deploy.

anya_enable: I'll schedule the enablement next Tue 10am PT and send calendar invite once staging key confirmed. Will attach the checklist and capture feedback directly in the playbook doc.

kevin_support: On it — opening netops change window request, will link SUP-1987 here once scheduled.

mike_platform: Investigating now, will post logs and reproduction steps in ENG-4219. If I need access I'll request a temporary staging token from Sarah.

sarah_sales: Thanks all. One more: customer has asked about quantization recommendations for latency. Mike — can we include a short note in the enablement about quantization levels that we recommend for triage workloads?

mike_platform: Yes — will prepare a 2-slide summary: performance vs quality tradeoffs (8-bit vs 4-bit), and include suggested engine configs.

lucas_cs: Great. I'll consolidate next steps and owners in the CS playbook doc and tag everyone. Please drop any follow-ups here. :memo:
